name: Realm: radiant uplands (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic sunlit upland photographed on location like a feature-film still - white stone monasteries and colonnades, terraced hillsides, clear mountain air and bright warm sun with soft golden shadows; any magic is a faint warmth in the light
notes: The light homeland as a place: use it with the backgrounds in backgrounds/fantasy/country/light/ (set components.realm).
